source: The same optimization can therefore have different value. Saving an activation write may matter enormously in training. Reducing persistent KV reads may matter more in long-context decode. Increasing batch size can improve weight reuse in inference but may increase queueing latency in an online service.
zh: 因此，相同的优化可能具有不同的价值。保存激活写入在训练中可能非常重要。在长上下文解码中，减少持久 KV 读取可能更重要。增加批量大小可以改善推理中的权重重用，但可能会增加在线服务中的排队延迟。
